setup.limits: No HA, physical power-loss or OS-cold claim. 1 CPU/4GiB engine; 1 CPU/512MiB per native IPC actor, swap disabled; external fsynced host witness/controller measured separately. Bind-mount I/O can bypass cgroup block counters.

compression.scope: Host-side compressibility of the verified CSV witness, streamed into a byte counter; not native engine compression. Timers cover compression calls, excluding file reads/hash/fsync.

result.scope: Ten rejected cross-container journal opens under independent live writers/readers, unchanged authoritative process and complete body witness; not cross-host lease fencing or capacity

costs.sampling_scope: 200ms plus serial Docker API/inspection overhead; generation-keyed CPU counters, charged memory and non-atomic directory samples, native cgroup CPU/memory/IO and PID1 RSS at checkpoints. Exact raw cadence retained; physical bind-mount I/O/latency unavailable; external host collector/witness overhead separate.

sampled_resources.scope: Approximately 100 ms plus API/inspection overhead; arithmetic sample mean, not heap or time-weighted mean. Sampling can miss short peaks; use native cgroup memory.peak and process RSS too. Docker daemon/VM overhead excluded.

fencing.scope: Ten native process opens from another container against the exact same journal storage. Exclusive-open rejection, not primary promotion or cross-host lease fencing.

scope: One synchronous Rayforce declared-scenario correctness experiment, not a DuckDB comparison or capacity benchmark. Native checkpoint counters are observed lower bounds on full lifetime CPU/I/O costs and observed memory peaks. Checkpoint exec overhead is included. Phase sample intervals crossing phase/generation boundaries are excluded. Memory means are sample means. Network values are cumulative generation counters, not per-phase traffic. Missing I/O/device latency and physical host I/O remain unavailable.
